name: Absolute Non-Refundable Educational Fee Forfeiture
description: Blanket refusal to refund tuition fees for unrendered educational services upon student withdrawal.
patterns: fee.*(?:non-refundable|cannot be claimed|forfeited in full).*even if.*(?:leaves|quits|discontinues)
(?:all fees paid|entire tuition).*(?:strictly non-refundable|not refundable under any circumstance)
legalSource: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Unfair Contract Terms) & Supreme Court in Islamic Academy of Education v. State of Karnataka (2003)
explanation: Retention of multi-year tuition fees for educational sessions a student did not attend constitutes an unfair trade practice under consumer protection jurisprudence.
caveat: Educational institutions may deduct proportionate administrative or seat-booking fees, but holding full multi-year fees is legally contestable.

name: Retention of Original Educational Certificates
description: Retention of original marksheets or degrees as financial collateral.
legalSource: University Grants Commission (UGC) Guidelines on Refund of Fees and Non-retention of Original Certificates (Sec 5)
explanation: Withholding original educational qualification certificates as security deposit or ransom is prohibited by statutory regulatory bodies.
caveat: Institutes have the right to physically inspect originals for verification, but must return them immediately upon verification.

name: Unilateral Batch or Faculty Reassignment
description: Unilateral right to alter promised batch timing, center location, or core faculty without student consent.
legalSource: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 - Section 2(47) (Unfair Trade Practice)
explanation: Permitting arbitrary changes to teaching personnel or timings without recourse may constitute a deficiency in educational service.
caveat: Reasonable schedule adjustments due to emergency or illness are standard; blanket discretionary rights warrant review.

name: Pro-Rata Tuition Fee Refund Baseline
description: Transparent pro-rata fee refund policy based on date of withdrawal.
legalSource: UGC Fee Refund Norms & AICTE Educational Guidelines
explanation: A policy that calculates refunds proportionately based on the formal withdrawal date reflects fair educational contracting.
caveat: Processing fee deduction is customary and acceptable if clearly specified.
